claims.claim: Uncertainty-penalized discounted policy objective
claims.qualification: Actor optimization, reward definitions, penalty weights, action bounds and training recipe are not sufficiently specified.

claims.source: Results, Eq. 1, p. 6 and Appendix A, pp. 20–21
claims.claim: One-step twin bias identity
claims.qualification: Displayed equation and appendix differ in the discount multiplying the transition residual; no logs or estimators available.

claims.claim: Four convolutional layers for 32 by 32 EIT
claims.qualification: Layer count and shape represented; kernels, strides, pooling and activations are engineering choices.

claims.claim: Two-block four-head transformer on 48 observations
claims.qualification: Feature width, positional representation and dropout are engineering choices.

claims.claim: EIT query and physiology keys and values in cross-attention
claims.qualification: Single image query; exact fusion details and missing-token gate are engineering choices.

claims.claim: Actor and critic use three 256-unit hidden layers
claims.qualification: Activation and Gaussian parameterization are engineering choices; actor is not trained.

claims.claim: NIG critic with nu=softplus+0.1 and alpha=softplus+1.1
claims.qualification: Positive beta offset and input encoding are engineering choices.

claims.claim: Aleatoric beta/(alpha-1), epistemic beta/((alpha-1)nu)
claims.qualification: Formula is present; current verification materials are unavailable.

claims.claim: NIG negative log likelihood and evidence regularizer
claims.qualification: Formula is present; regularizer weight is not reported.

claims.claim: Threshold order statistic at alpha 0.10
claims.qualification: Small calibration sets use infinity when the rank exceeds sample count; strict exceedance defers.

claims.claim: Behavioral-cloning default action
claims.qualification: Behavior policy fitting, conditioning, and data are not provided.

claims.claim: Patient-specific one-compartment lung twin and one-step meta-adaptation
claims.qualification: Transition equations, calibration likelihood and optimization settings are not supplied.

claims.claim: Clinical reward and EIT and safety penalties
claims.qualification: Weights of clinical changes appear, but units, normalization, component definitions and penalty scales are incomplete.

claims.claim: Eligibility and patient-level 70/15/15 severity-stratified splits
claims.qualification: Cohort-specific diagnosis mapping, severity strata, extraction rules, and accessible study data are missing.

claims.claim: AUROC, Brier, equal-mass ECE/MCE and decision-curve net benefit
claims.qualification: Ties across equal-mass bins follow stable input order as an engineering convention.

claims.claim: AUPRC, BCa confidence intervals, DeLong, Holm, logistic calibration, I-squared, Cohen d and paired bootstrap
claims.qualification: Not implemented or evaluated.

claims.claim: Prospective cohort and clinician interaction evaluation
claims.qualification: Institution-held observations and adjudications unavailable.

claims.claim: EIT surrogate and twin audits, ablations and baseline comparisons
claims.qualification: Bedside EIT, model outputs, trajectories, experiment configurations and baseline code are unavailable; reported inflation factors disagree.

claims.claim: 48 configurations and 500-epoch ceiling for baseline controllers; five seed analysis
claims.qualification: No equivalent configuration or training on datasets has been executed.

claims.claim: Theorems 1–3, propositions 4–5 and corollary 6
claims.qualification: Mathematical statements are not implemented as empirical guarantees; the manuscript contains unresolved logical and equation discrepancies.
